p.WHICH-PAGE-IS-YOURS: This project works under the working rules. If `WORKING-RULES.local.md` does not exist, the project is in ordinary mode and the table below does not apply. If it exists, find your line in its "Tiers" block and read only your row; if it has no line for you, a central session is a bounded lead and a worker is an executor. The pages are in `vibevm/vibedeps/org.vibevm.world.working-rules/1.0.12/rules/`.

td.ROW-OPEN-LEAD-READS: `protocol.md`, `WORKING-RULES.project.md`, `WORKING-RULES.local.md`; also `decomposing.md` when preparing a completion list for a bounded lead

td.ROW-BOUNDED-LEAD-READS: `lead-bounded.md`, the "Current mode" block of `WORKING-RULES.local.md`, the completion list it names

p.PROJECT-OWNED-FILES: `WORKING-RULES.project.md` (project policy) and `WORKING-RULES.local.md` (local binding, untracked) are project-owned files at the project root. The package never writes them; without them the session works in ordinary mode.
